- The security/compliance team requires that no customer data (inputs or KV cache) be processed on infrastructure that is shared at the tenant level with other customers. - Dedicated/reserved capacity with logical isolation is preferred from a cost/speed perspective, but it will not meet our compliance bar without additional contractual and technical guarantees (and an architecture review).

Immediate asks:
- Can you provide SOC2 Type II evidence and a short note describing how Redwood enforces tenant isolation at the runtime layer?
- A rough timeline and cost delta for Private VPC vs Dedicated (ballpark is fine for internal budgeting).

Marissa / team — quick assessment:

Dedicated (Reserved Capacity):
- Pros: fastest to stand up for a POC, lower lead time (days–weeks) and lower cost.
- Cons: by default Dedicated is a tenant-isolated runtime but still runs on shared networking and cluster infrastructure; for customers with a strict "no co-tenancy" SaaS policy this is typically a blocker unless we can offer additional guarantees (e.g., dedicated nodes at an HW level and contractual indemnities). Achieving HW-level tenancy isolation within our Dedicated product requires engineering time and may not be feasible for an initial POC.

Private VPC / On-prem:
- Pros: satisfies strict isolation requirement (customer-owned VPC or on-prem physical isolation). Clear path for SOC2/arch review and audit access.
- Cons: longer lead time (estimate 6–8 weeks for a standard Private VPC deployment with our current playbook), higher cost vs Dedicated.

Recommended next steps to move forward:
1) Share SOC2 Type II redacted copy and a 1-pager on runtime tenant isolation (Monica to attach).
2) If FinSecure confirms Private VPC is required, we should schedule a 30–45 minute architecture intake with their infra/security team to gather: preferred cloud account details, VPC/subnet constraints, egress policies, KMS/HSM requirements, and compliance audit window.
3) I’ll prepare a rough order-of-magnitude cost delta and timeline (private vs dedicated) once we have the infra intake answers — ETA: 48 hours after intake.

I’ve attached a stub SOC2 redaction and a short runtime isolation summary for initial review.

Cheers,
Rishi
Head of Solutions & Security, Redwood Inference
